versions.changelog:
- Added new test script `scripts/test_clean.py`.
- Updated README and SKILL documentation to improve installation instructions, clarify root vs user-local install methods, and document language override using `--lang` or `DROPMAIL_LANG`.
- Removed `skill-card.md`.
- Minor documentation and command reference improvements for clarity.

- Major update: Security & privacy documentation added; public security, privacy, and access disclosures integrated into the skill.
- Expanded SKILL.md with detailed sections on what is accessed, privacy precautions, and explicit security measures.
- Clarified that only GuerrillaMail API is contacted, no credentials or shell execution occur, and local data is strictly isolated.
- Removed mention of the obsolete skill-card.md.
- README and .gitignore files added for improved usability and developer guidance.
- No changes to commands or core usage; documentation now gives clearer safety information for all users.
Fix: Add SSL context to dropmail.py for macOS compatibility

Initial release of DropMail skill.

- Create and manage disposable email addresses via GuerrillaMail.
- Supports creating, listing, refreshing, reading, and removing temporary emails.
- Local data storage using SQLite at `~/.dropmail/dropmail.db`.
- Inbox messages are cached and can be browsed or read in full.
- Handles session and cookie management for each temporary email.
- Emails expire after 60 minutes; offline access to cached messages is supported.
